name: ascii-wallpaper
description: Animated wallpapers drawn in characters behind the conversation in the desktop and mobile apps: a turtle lagoon, clouds, koi, jellyfish, paper boats, fireflies and a moonlit night

scene.title: Wallpaper
scene.description: The scene behind the conversation. off shows the app's own background. /wallpaper changes it for one session.

glass.title: Frosted panels
glass.description: Frost the panels over the wallpaper so text stays easy to read. Off leaves the panels as they are.

veil.title: Soften wallpaper
veil.description: How much the wallpaper fades toward the page color, from 0 (none) to 0.8. Raise it if text is hard to read.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast the scene moves, from 0.25 to 3. 1 is the original pace.
